create_critical_gradient_transport_model: create a CriticalGradientTransportModel instance to calculate ion and electron heat transport coefficients
build_runtime_params_cgm: build a RuntimeParams dataclass instance with alpha, chi_stiff, chi_e_i_ratio, chi_D_ratio, and VR_D_ratio parameters
calculate_gyrobohm_diffusivity: calculate the GyroBohm diffusivity from ion mass, magnetic field, and temperature profiles
compute_critical_gradient: compute the critical normalized logarithmic ion temperature gradient R/L_Ti using temperature ratios and safety factor
return_turbulent_transport: return a TurbulentTransport object with ion heat, electron heat, electron particle diffusivity, and electron convection coefficients
